notes.title: Update: 0.6.3.0
notes.content:
Balance changes

-Skill and upgrade runes will now automatically pick up walking over them giving players a choice of 3 skills/upgrades to choose from

-Recycling skills/upgrades is no longer possible

-Bard will not directly buff and deal damage instead of stacking notes and expelling them on the 4th attack

-Mage has 2 new skills
  -Arcane shield: conjure a shield a shield slowing enemies inside before exploding for # damage
  -Mindskewer: summon a # of projectiles each dealing # damage to a single enemy

-Lightning storm and fireball have been removed from the mage and added to the global skill pool

-Certain skills will focus higher priority targets like bosses/elites, included skills:
  -Mindskewer
  -Fireball
  -Rain of arrows
  -Axe throw
  -Arcane disk 

-Imps base health pool lowered from 100 > 50
-Imps will now block players from passing through them
-imps will block projectiles from passing through them (they still take the damage)
-Imps will summon 2 extra imps to their sides will move and turn much slower, when they spawn will create an impassible barrier attempting to choke out the player if they fail to escape.

-Added new unique enemy
  -Batswarm: a flock of bats will attempt to rush past the player

-Shops will stay for a second longer after the safe zone timer run out to complete any purchases made before the timer officially hit 0


Bug Fixes

-Fixed a bug where controller icons would not properly show up when swapping out new skills
-Fixed  bug where you could not navigate past a sold out item in the main menu shop with a controller
-Fixed a bug where the bard would infinitely gain stacking regen until becoming immortal
-Fixed a bug where the rangers smokebomb would set the enemy speed to 0

notes.title: Upcoming skills and upgrade changes
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135358/b95211d6e6839620b26d09e51aba332836c40115.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135358/40b3363d6c8fbd1d7a97f075277583cf324c1f89.png[/img][/url]

I thank everyone for the feedback, it helps me make a better product, while i can never please everyone i have to take weigh in all the feedback and take peoples issues in consideration and make decisions based on that!

Never the less there have been a few key issues that arose and i want to address.

1. Picking up upgrades and skills is difficult while being hounded by enemies. 
  -While i thought adding a safe space for shopping would mostly fix this it seems this is an issue that persist, so in an upcoming update i have changed that skills and upgrades are automatically picked up when walking over them.

2. Players are too much at mercy of rng.
 -Picking up a skill or upgrade will now offer a set of 3 choices, greatly increasing the odds you will get an upgrade or befitting what build you want to work towards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135358/51e15d449e210d228770063b48c6dfa7fdc9aa55.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135358/5097c618aebad33cf425bd1a97a59aaf321d5f11.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135358/8aa9cba720b88a6a0ca2b21ad01f519422f435d0.jpg[/img]

There will be more in the update, but these are 2 key changes you can expect soon!

notes.title: 0.6 Class warfare Update OUT NOW
notes.content:
[b]The Big one is here! [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Classes![/b] - Along with the warrior unlock 3 new classes! Mage, a wielder of arcane magics, The Ranger, a nimble long range sniper, and the bard, support your allies with soothing tunes or devastate enemies with harsh tones.

[*] [b]Skills and upgrades overhaul[/b] - With this update comes an entire new system of power, each class will start with a unique attack and 2 skills, you can acquire new skills swap out existing skills with new skills and even stack multiple copies of the same skill!
Upgrades are now independent from skills and each upgrade will benefit a certain skill in a way!

[*] [b]Experience is gone[/b] - exp has been replaced with money! Money will allow you to buy upgrades, healing new skills speed boost from many different shops around the map, including a donut vending machine a slot machine and even an investment terminal? 
A lot of money is also hidden in crates for that early boost of capital!

[*] [b]New way to win[/b] - The Proginator has been removed as the final encounter bosses will now drop gems, these are keys to open up the teleporter bringing you to new lands in future updates! For now, this is your key to winning!

[*] [b]And more:[/b] including permanent upgrades bought from the main menu, steam achievements and overall improvements. 
[/list]
